notes.title: Polygod Launches!
notes.content:
Polygod is live!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/fd74873c812ccd33432965d629cfb02bdfe3e40e.jpg[/img]

Early Access has finally come to an end. It has been an epic 2 year journey and we could not have done it without such a supportive community. We at Krafted Games thank you! :) 

Below is a list of all the polish that has been done in the days leading up to launch and includes all the bug fixes, balance changes and added content.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the snake boss was on fire when dropping into the first boss fight.
[*]Removed NPCs from Online Coop and Splitscreen Coop.
[*]Removed Statues from Online Coop and Splitscreen Coop.
[*]Fixed "Flawless Victory" text for boss fights 3 and 4.
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies fall in Level 4.
[*]Fixed gun shadows in splitscreen coop.
[*]Fixed a bug where jump pads would occassionally not spawn.
[*]Fixed Boss altars.
[*]Reworked controller support system.
[*]Fixed a bug where Electro Shot would damage the player.
[*]Fixed a bug with Torpedo Shot's camera.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player was unable to control the afterimage of Flying Thunder God.
[*]Fixed a bug where enemies would immediately attack you after you fall into a level.
[*]Fixed a bug where Power Lease blessings would be permanant.
[*]Fixed a bug where temporary movement speed was not rounded off to 2 decimals.
[*]Fixed a bug where Chaos Collosus would fall off the map.
[*]Changed "Quit to Title" in the 6th Room of Rest to say "Save and Quit to Title" in the Pause Menu.
[*]Made the Blessed of the Meek message to only appear once.
[*]Fixed enemy SFX from playing when paused.
[*]Blessed of the Meek was not increasing damage. This has been fixed.
[*]Fixed Ethereal bullets.
[*]Muted sound when Polygod is minimised.
[/list]

[b]Added Content [/b]
[list][*]Added graphics options.
[*]Added custom icons for button and keyboard controls.
[*]Added snake to the title screen.
[*]Added in the Blessed of the Meek icon to the left side of the screen once activated.
[*]Added in the Sinful Sinner icon to the left side of the screen once activated.
[*]Added a display bar for activating Truth Bomb.
[*]Added 25 new achievements.
[/list]

[b]Sound Effects[/b]
[list][*]Added menu music and UI sounds.
[*]Added a Master Volume option.
[*]Added new footstep, jump and land sounds.
[*]Added new statue unlock sound.
[*]Death sound effect volume has been lowered.
[*]Added a Truth Bomb sound effect.
[*]Added a new gun sound.
[*]Added a feature when the sound is lowered in altar menus and the pause menu.
[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[*]Changed blood tithe to having a 20% chance of healing you that maxes out at 2 hp per enemy and 5 hp per boss.
[*]Swapped Behemoth and Chaos Copter. The Behemoth is now in level 6, and the Chaos Copter in level 7.
[*]Trigger Happy does not take your Rate of Fire over the max Rate of Fire.
[*]Changed the drop rates of Health Orbs in the later levels.
[*]Changed the Behemoth's bullet speed.
[*]Chaos Colossus has has his health knocked down to 2000000 HP.
[/list]

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
[list][*]Fixed multiplayer connectivity issues.
[*]Fixed jump pads in Multiplayer Levels.
[*]Fixed normal altars on client side.
[*]Fixed the crate weapon parts displayed at altars.
[*]Fixed Bossfight 4 Lighting.
[*]Updated Level 4's altars.
[*]Fixed a bug where Tesla Towers would shoot continuously.
[*]Fixed a bug where Flybombers were much larger than they should be.
[*]Fixed a bug where Light Feet didn't add jump height.
[*]Fixed one of the skies in Level 3.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Level 4 Boss didn't have a health bar.
[*]Fixed a bug where the mosquitoes would drain health from only the host.
[*]Fixed a bug where you wouldn't lose souls when you fell off the map.
[/list]

notes.title: Saved seeds + Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Today's update is a rather small one with just a few fixes and one new feature: [b]a seed-saving system[/b]. You can now save seeds that you like through the pause menu in-game, and the death screen. Your saved seeds are accessible in the Saved Seeds menu which is in the New Game menu.

We hope you find this addition useful. As always, any and all feedback is welcome!

[b] Bug Fixes [/b] 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where Second Self would not respawn you at the start of the dungeon in some levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could not walk under the gun parts at the altars in level 5.
[*]Fixed a bug where the level 7 floors were red and white instead of black and white.
[*]Fixed a bug where having Indomitable Will and Trigger Happy would double the rate of fire increase when Trigger Happy was active.
[*]Fixed a bug in the acquire blessing randomness system.
[/list] 

[b] Added Content [/b]

notes.title: NPC Update + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[b] Hey everyone! [/b]

Today’s update has something special in store for any player who’s ever been curious about the strange little folk in the Polyverse…

That’s right, we’d added new NPC content!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/c04ed3ecdf64ef4523f6d3ddc2b02f6f7acca3ef.jpg[/img]

Dr Dando, everyone’s favourite nutty Zoologist, has some new information about the creatures in Polygod, and if you’re lucky, a tale about the origins of Faceless the First. It turns out he’s quite a chatty guy.

Maya’s got some new musings, too, on her preferred topic of... you guessed it: FREEDOM! But will she ever actually be free as a bee? (Hint: yes. We game devs took pity on her and made it so.)

If you care to chat to the other NPCs, I’m sure you’ll spot a new line here or there, or perhaps a pun that would even make Faceless facepalm.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/7ad470f0a1bc3f1ea1b05e2294b3f60e466a6d92.jpg[/img]

We've also changed the sizes of the levels: they no longer get bigger as you progress through the game. They're all the same size as the first level. Let us know how you find this change, as it will affect balance, difficulty and the time it takes to complete the game.

Have fun!

[h1] Patch Notes [/h1] 

[b] Bug Fixes [/b] 
[list]
    [*] Fixed a bug where Proof of Stake would not affect the Level 1 and 2 Holy Champion.
    [*] Fixed a bug where Flying Thunder God would not allow you to move your afterimage.
    [*] Fixed a bug where the Drill Eye in Level 3 would spawn within walls.
    [*] Fixed a bug where the player could not continue from the Blessed are the Meek message when a controller is connected.
    [*] Fixed a bug in the Death Menu where the player could not see which button is selected when using a controller.
    [*] Fixed a bug in Splitscreen in the Dark Room of Rest where player 2 could not continue from the message.
    [*] Fixed a bug where you could walk on lava in the 6th Room of Rest.
    [*] Fixed a bug where the extra damage display was showing too many decimal places.
[/list] 

[b] Balance Changes [/b] 
[list]
    [*] Changed the size of all the levels. All the levels are the same size as the first level. The later levels are now smaller than before.
[/list] 

[b] Added Content [/b] 
[list]
    [*] Added gun parts to the altars.
    [*] Added a Back button to the Character Select Menu.
    [*] Made minor changes to the dialogue of the following NPCs: Kanox, Brontes, Bran, Tau..
    [*] Made bigger changes to the dialogue of the following NPCs: Maya, Dr Dando, Ark.
    [*] Added a quest to free Maya in exchange for a reward.
    [*] Added a quest to help Dando in exchange for a reward.
    [*] Added new Polygod Creator characters to the Credit Scene.
[/list] 

[b] Other Changes [/b] 
[list]
    [*] Changed the position of the Back and Resume button in the Pause Menu.
    [*] NPCs no longer switch to angry dialogue after being shot once: they will get angry after losing a small percentage of their health.
    [*] Optimised the game for an increase in FPS.
    [*] Optimised pathfinding
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Changes and Special Blessings!
notes.content:
Today's patch is quite a large one where we have fixed a few bugs, improved the balance of the game and added two special state blessings which cannot be bought and can only be achieved by meeting specific requirements. However we are very excited to introduce the new content and fixes to the community!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/eaf06f7ecd4b3f74ab22e0e87627a6c58dd47f5d.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/dd161e95d297edf68501c0ec0348134ee097d647.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/3d36cdad2000a5e80fd50719005e86ff6fe54848.jpg[/img]

[h1]Blessed are the Meek[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/cd605cb37cc51aa4807903552fcbcc818fe732ef.png[/img]
Blessed are the Meek is a blessings bestowed to you by Truth who will increase your damage if your are on a level with a particularly under-powered weapon. We implemented this change to balance for players who received unfair or unworkable seeds due to a lack of base fire power. this also allows players to ride out weaker builds to a later stage in the game where they can acquire the damage at which blessed are the meek will no longer be active.


[h1]Simple Sinner[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/6b6f8c4f6de85be9f70ab1462c1386fa28e0ee3a.png[/img]
Simple sinner was created to encourage hardcore player and speed runners. After beating the first Holy Champion certain Faceless Ones (namely faceless Ones who don't have any blessings) will feel empowered and this resolve and inner strength will weaken future Holy Champions. This means it is now possible to beat the entire game without buying any blessings, this is of course very difficult.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug with Compound X82 where the player would not get the temporary damage increase.
[*]Fixed a bug with Blood Tax where the player would not get the damage multiplier.
[*]Fixed a bug with Communism where Deadly Discount would still affect the prices.
[*]Fixed a bug with Communism where it would affect the price of Boss Blessings.
[*]Fixed some walls in Level 4 which were missing colliders.
[*]Fixed some plumbing in Level 3 where the player would get stuck in some pipes.
[*]Fixed a bug with Bonus Bessing where when choosing Divine Intervention, Power Swop, Random Swop, Select Next, Sacrificial Gamble or Power Lease the player would automatically get those blessings again at the respawned altar.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player would take damage from Heart of Dance when in the air.
[*]Fixed a bug where the afterimages in the Level 7 Boss Fight would stay around once the you have defeated the boss.
[*]Fixed a bug where the descriptions for Blessings in the Blessings Menu would clip off the right side of the screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where an altar would show the Proof of Stake description when a controller was connected.
[*]Fixed a bug where when changing selection of Blessings at an altar, a Blessing would sometimes not swop correctly with the currently shown Blessing.
[*]Fixed a bug where Press "E" to commune did not disappear once inside the altar menu. 
[*]A Loading Screen appears when going into Multiplayer.
[*]Divine Truth has been renamed to Truth Bomb.
[*]Fixed a bug where the Submarine would not die from Truth Bomb.
[*]Fixed a bug where Heavy Artillery previously took away 3 movement speed. It has been adjusted back to a 2 movement speed deduction.
[*]Fixed a bug where if you take away a Blessing that increases your jump height, you would still have the increased jump height.
[*]Fixed a bug where you could not quit Multiplayer when using a controller.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could not sacrifice Blessings at an Altar or a statue.
[*]Fixed a bug where, if activated, right-click Blessings fire right after an altar.
[*]Fixed a bug where Proximity Mines would not explode after time. They have been given a 20 second selfdestruct timer.
[*]Fixed a bug where Vampiric Aura would ignore your health shield when losing health.
[*]Fixed a bug where having Vampiric Aura and Unstable Concoction would lead to becoming invincible.
[*]Fixed a bug where Furious Core would only increment your damage by 0.5 per stack. It now increments by 1 damage.
[*]Fixed a bug where the explosion from Exploding Core would not damage enemies.
[*]Fixed a bug where Hand of Chaos would double your damage per charge incorrectly.
[*]Fixed a bug where having Adrenaline and Inconquerable Will or Adrenaline and Indomitable Will would incorrectly give you the extra fire rate and damage.
[*]Fixed Inconquerable Will to reflect its counterpart Indomitable Will in terms of damage and rate of fire increases.
[*]Fixed a bug where when receiving random new Blessings you could receive Boss Blessings. This has been changed.[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list][*]Added an effect once Divine Truth is activated. 
[*]Adjusted the height of seed name in title screen.
[*]Balanced the Rate of Fire to now steadily increase per level.[/list]

[b]Typos[/b]
[list][*]Corrected the Blood Tax description from "taxes you 1 hp every 20s" to "taxes you 2 hp every 20s".
[*]Corrected Faceless the Heavy's blessings in the Character Select screen to say Listless Core and not Heavy Core.
[*]Corrected Furious Core's description to state "Damage done will max out after 3 hits". This has been changed from 5 hits.
[*]Adjusted  the press 'A' in the character select screen when a controller is connected.[/list]

[b]Splitscreen Coop[/b]
[list][*]Changed the Splitscreen altar system to reflect the Online Multiplayer system.
[*]Increased the minimum vertical x angle lock on the gun.
[*]When starting a Splitscreen coop game, it will choose a random seed for the players.
[*]Added a retry button for Splitscreen.
[*]Fixed a graphic where the Babylon update had not been applied tothe Altar room or the End Door in Level 1.
[*]Fixed a bug where the player could not advance past the Level 2 Boss Fight.
[*]Fixed a bug where when transitioning levels, the fade was not alligned properly.
[*]Fixed a bug where the players could not use right click powerups and could not switch between them.
[*]Fixed a bug where Hand of Mazu and Spiritual Successor where not working in Splitscreen.
[*]Added the new art style to coop.
[*]When choosing a character, the camera will skip to your next unlocked character.[/list]

[b]Added Content[/b]
[list][*]New Blessing added: Blessed are the Meek
[*]New Blessing added: Simple Sinner
[*]Added controller support to the Dark Room of Rest.
[*]Added controller support to the Death Screen.
[*]Added controller support to sacrifices to Statues.
[*]Added a visual in the Pause Menu showing temporary stat buffs.[/list]

notes.title: Big Balance Changes + Bug Fixes and some Polish!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today's patch has a bunch of balance changes designed to make some of the blessings which are chosen less often more viable. We have also added a bunch of new visual effects to make the results of what a blessing does more clear.

[*]Defensive Reaction has been given a cooldown. It starts with a 3 second cooldown and decreases depending on the amount of Defensive Reaction blessings the player has.
[*]Copter Boot has been given a 3 second cooldown. The cooldown decreases with the amount of Copter Boots blessings the player has.
[*]Chaos Armour has been given a change in percentage of damage reduction. It starts as a 20% damage reduction and increases by a further 10% for each additional Chaos Armour taken.
[*]Arm of Chaos has been given a 1 second cooldown and now deals damage in a wider area.
[*]Blood Tithe has been changed to a percentage chance of receiving health on hit. 
[*]Return Shot has been changed to now deal double damage on the returning bullet.
[*]Updated the Split Screen character select to include all 15 characters.[/list]

notes.title: Massive Multiplayer Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/8978c20955e720afc86fdafac335ad5bf9e83497.png[/img]

Today I'm very excited to bring you our largest and longest in development update yet! This update is all about Jolly Co-operation as we've finally completed the much requested Co-Op multiplayer option while also improving and polishing our multiplayer versus mode and other multiplayer features.

[h1]Co-operative Multiplayer[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/e36ab79e941d2451901fe49b06fd6c2cdf648a60.jpg[/img]


Players must work together to gather souls and acquire blessings in order to defeat the Holy Champions. The gods will offer the same blessings to players at a particular altar however if another player takes a particular blessing it will not be removed from the blessings on offer from the god. This is because the Gods can bestow infinite blessings and are not limited by mortals choices. Up to 4 players can play together in Co-Operative mode. 

The following blessings have been left out of Co-Op for complexity reasons and will be added in a future update: Whirlwind Shot, Stun Shot, Power Lease.

[h1]Multiplayer Versus[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/f69ad24ecb9ab406ca6301c37452a851f3c35b67.jpg[/img]

Multiplayer Versus has finally been reactivated with all the relevant single player blessings included. None of the boss blessings are available in versus mode as none of the players defeat any Holy Champions in this mode and the boss blessings can be quite unbalanced if used against other players. All playable characters are unlocked for all players while we test our multiplayer modes so that the Early Access community can help us balance all these characters. In the final release players will only be able to access characters they have unlocked in single player for multiplayer. Some single player blessings such as Select Next or Divine Intervention which only work with Altars have are not present in Versus mode. Private game functionality has been added to versus mode.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug regarding floating jump pads in Level 5.
[*]Fixed a bug where Kanox rediscovered levitation in Level 4.[/list]

[b]Added Content[/b]
[list][*]Online Cooperative Multiplayer.
[*]Ark has been given a conclusion to his narrative.
[*]Added fountains to the Garden of Gaia.[/list]

[b]Balance Changes[/b]
[list][*]Wrathful Endeavour's explosions now instantly kill enemies.
[*]Torpedo Shot's torpedoes now instantly kill enemies.
[*]Hand of Mazu's travel distance before the bullet clones appear has been decreased.
Pulsating Core's frequency of pulse bursts has been increased.[/list]

notes.title: The Chaotic Update!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/2b38274e589094d24ea445874bc0800e3705ddba.png[/img]

After far too long of a delay we are proud to introduce our biggest update yet, the Chaotic Update. In this update we have added the sixth level and boss fight, updated the random generation system, daily dungeon leaderboard, updated all the boss fights and prepared the servers for the upcoming online co-operative multiplayer update which has been a major undertaking.

[h1]Level 6 Chaos the Abyss[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/57504482240edd9863915f683c640237ca273a81.png[/img]

The most notable part of this update is the addition of level 6 and its respective boss fight. This level is called the Abyss of Chaos.

[h1]New Boss Power ups with Chaos' Holy Champion![/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/c1226f05d31180166ce922a77eb907ccfeb5a956.png[/img]
[b]Chaotic Corruption[/b]
Adds a damage multiplier to your bullets based on the distance the bullet has travelled. The shorter the distance the higher the multiplier. Does not stack.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/f713d0b9acaf8dc905e127ffd933f8fa52526f43.png[/img]
[b]Chaos Armour[/b]
Gives a 25% damage reduction. Acquiring additional Chaos Armour blessings will increase the percentage of damage reduction.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/d0126d4ab3eb3abf1706d6b7f54309bb32ea96c1.png[/img]
[b]Arm of Chaos[/b]
Activates a melee attack when you tap the 'R' key. The melee attack kills beasts instantly. Arm of Chaos has a 10 second cooldown. Acquiring additional Arm of Chaos blessings will decrease the cooldown by 5 seconds.

[h1]For the speed runners[/h1]
[list]
[*]Blessings are now linked to the dungeon seed. This means that for any particular seed the blessings which spawn will be the same every-time. The implication of this is that now for the daily dungeon the time that someone gets will be 100% representative of player skill as the only differentiating factors are player decisions.

[*]Timelines built into the blessing link. We thought it would be fun to create alternate timelines which are triggered by using red portals (the harder alternative boss fights). When a red portal is used the future blessing spawns for a seed are changed according to a timeline with a red portal. Every-time a red portal is used a new timeline opens up with a different set of blessings unique to that seed. This means that speed runners should optimally check all the alternate timelines to find the most efficient combinations of blessings for a particular seed in order to get the best time possible.
[/list]

[h1]Boss Health bars[/h1]
We thought it was about time we added names to our bosses as well as on screen health bars for them. The health bar is visible in the bottom right hand of the screen creating a diagonal symmetry with the player health bar.

[h1]Multiplayer temporarily disabled for Online Co-op Preparation[/h1]
We have made huge amounts of progress in the complicated endeavour of adding full online cooperative multiplayer functionality to the game. We are almost ready to add Online Co-op to the working build but want to perform a few more tests first. We have temporarily disabled the multiplayer menu while we work on the servers and stress test them for the co-op implementation which will also include an update to the multiplayer versus mode. This implementation is planned for our next update!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed the Catch22 Blessing. When active it was previously giving a 5x damage increase. It has now been changed to match the description in giving a 2.2x damage increase.

[*]The random generation system has been optimised. This has improved the randomness of the levels.
[*]Fixed a bug where NPCs and the Mini Jellyfish would get infinite health when the player had the Unstable Soul blessing.[/list]

[b]Balance Update[/b]
[list][*]Increased the weight of the Sphere'O (Level 1) and the Jawbreaker (Level 1) so the push back from getting shot is not so drastic.

[b]Added Content[/b]

notes.content:
Happy New Year to everyone! I hope everybody has had a great holiday season and I'm excited to bring you todays update. Our dedicated community has grown so much over the period and we are very happy!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/e8ba528b60b448ff8c98eac06d48ae941e6ae8c8.png[/img]

The first change was the addition of Colour Pallets to the levels. This change was suggested by a member of the community and we liked it so much that we just had to implement it. From now on each level will randomly generated as one of 4 colour pallets providing additional visual variety to the levels which will especially benefit players who are stuck in the earlier stages.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/fedb547facf300a1293c954a13898813b5af36f1.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/0ec718f59a26ec95a6f6534aca323ec18c858afb.png[/img]

[h1]NPC Update[/h1]
Introducing Dr Dando and the Mysterious Tau. These two have some new information about this strange other world that you constantly find yourself in.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/a7ae41f9f1c1fb72b598ca1b31bafcec2a1d8f5e.jpg[/img]

Brontes has also received an extreme makeover and now features a higher polygon count.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/8253cd271a8f4622f74054765128c18c3c0ccdd0.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/fa3410870ceebe8030dce4307ea70135c7bc3d79.png[/img]

[h1]Controller Support[/h1]
The largest piece of content from the update is the addition of Partial Controller Support. We designed the system to work with Xbox 360 controllers and are currently in the process of acquiring a Steam Controller in order to make sure that everything works smoothly on all controller types. You will still need a mouse and keyboard to launch the game and select quality and resolution settings and the controller support hasn't been fully implemented with the multiplayer menus. However controllers will work on all the main single player menus and the main game experience. 

[h1]Control Scheme Change Defaults[/h1]
E on keyboard is 'A' on Xbox 360
TAB on keyboard is 'RB' on Xbox 360
ESC on keyboard is 'B' on Xbox 360
SPACE on keyboard is 'LEFT TRIGGER' on Xbox 360
MOUSE-CLICK on mouse is 'RIGHT TRIGGER' on Xbox 360
RB and LB on Xbox 360 are also used to toggle blessings options at an Altar.

[b]Justifying Jump on Left Trigger[/b]
The reason the jump button has been default mapped to left trigger instead of the standard 'A' button was so that players can have both thumbs on the analog sticks while also being able to jump so that they can smoothly adjust the game camera and their own guns aim while also being able to dodge and shoot unhindered.


[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Fixed a bug where the Yellow Submarine Torpedos would collide with the Yellow Submarine itself.

notes.title: General Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, your feedback has been amazing and has really helped us find a lot of bugs and address them. Here is a list of the latest updates and fixes.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where quitting to title in level would load the retry functionality.
[*]Fixed a bug where the footsteps and jumping sound were too loud in relation to the other sound effects.
[*]Changed the in air movement system to give the player more control. From now on the player has full movement control in air as they would on the ground. This means players can jump in one direction while shooting in another direction without having the mouse movement change the direction of jump travel. Players can now also stop dead during a jump arc by releasing the movement keys, this is useful for if the player wants to land very accurately and a full jump arc would overshoot (this helps particularly at high speeds). This also means jump arcs won’t auto complete so it’s up to the player to choose their direction of travel when using a jump pad.
[*]Fixed a bug where laser beams would collide with the proximity mine  distance trigger.

notes.title: Seeded Generation, new Blessings and UI updates!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the community response has been tremendous and instrumental in helping us get these updates to you frequently!

Todays update comes in three parts: new Blessings (which were submitted by community members), seeded generation in the levels and a blessing commune UI revamp.

We also addressed a fair amount of the bugs which were reported and have been working our best to squash them all! Any and all bug reports help tremendously.

[h1]Seeded Generation![/h1]

You can now seed levels in order to retry a dungeon you played which you thought was extra hard or had some unique feature you want to share. You can name the seed anything and it will generate a play-through based on your choice. 

You can also randomize the seed to try out different seeded generations which you may want to come back to. 

We have also included a daily seed feature which lets you play a consistent random generation for 24 hours. This way players can compete to see who can do the daily seed the fastest.

Seed generation also helps with bug testing because if you encounter an issue in a specific generation you can easily share the seed on the forums and we will be able to see the error in the dungeon it occurred in. 

Our favourite seeds so far are: 
[list][*]DarkSouls
[*]Gaia
[*]Minecraft
[*]Quake
[*]TheBeatles
[*]BranTheBottled
[*]DOCTORDANDO
[*]MAZU
[*]Rogue-like
[*]fps
[*]wwrgsrgs
[/list]

[h1]UI Changes![/h1]

The commune blessing menu has been updated, the back and next bars have been removed in favour of a more visual design.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/20e6a27439057fa44a8c28c4953d01bd00b2ad32.jpg[/img]

All 4 blessings which are being added to the game today were submitted by community members. Shout outs to @Sid and @mjmoneghan for the ideas which were submitted in the blessings and balance ideas section of the community hub.

[b]Soul Core[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/32114cb031d759624c2b01a96f98d8d17775c9f1.png[/img] 
Soul Core causes each bullet you fire to cost a soul. However upon killing an enemy you will gain souls equal to the number of times you hit that enemy + 2 extra souls. Acquiring additional Soul Core blessings will increase the number of extra souls. Costs 10 souls.

[b]Light Heart[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/cb6f4d4e50522daa50a2c570a8aef58b8b4e29f6.png[/img] 
Light Heart increases your hit points and jump height but decreases your rate of fire. Acquiring additional will activate double jump. Costs 10 souls.

[b]Blood Sacrifice[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/303b194cb423214d2d94cdb4de2569b165d8aa36.png[/img]
Blood Sacrifice will give you a random blessing in exchange for 2 maximum hit points.

[b]Impact Boots[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26475741/54c16c38e029597af5a03cfa09638834d99a47e3.png[/img] 
Impact Boots will cause you to release a burst of bullets in all directions whenever you fall from a height of one storey or greater. Acquiring additional impact boots will increase the number of bullets released. Costs 10 souls.

notes.title: Invincibility Frames! + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey everyone, thanks so much for the amazing feedback and community response it's really been amazing!

I wanted to do a quick patch addressing the most prominent things people addressed before I do a much larger update at the end of the week which will include some more content.

The most prominent change everyone asked for was the addition of invincibility frames, I can completely see why this change would suit Polygod and have implemented it.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invincibility frames have been added to combat. Specifically 3 frames of invincibility after you have been hit.
[*] The GUI for the cross-hair has been updated to be significantly more accurate, it has also been adjusted to 100% accurate with Laser Shots at longer distances.
[*] Laser shots has had a bug fixed where if you missed an object the laser beam would not spawn. The beams always spawn regardless of whether you hit or not.
[*] It was discovered that you could exit the level and go back to the most recent room of rest, this was not intended, exiting the level (or boss fight) is considered a forfeit and you must restart the game (this is a rogue-like). This was due to a save load error, the error has been addressed and the system will work as follows. In the room of rest you can at any time exit the game and continue your current play-through from that room of rest at a later stage, however if you are in the game level or a boss fight and choose to quit to title this will be considered a forfeit and you will be sent back to the beginning of the game. The GUI in the pause menu will reflect this change with different text namely it will say "SAVE AND QUIT TO TITLE" when in a room of rest and "QUIT TO TITLE" in any other location.
[/list]

Please keep the feedback coming it is hugely helpful! I have added all other received feedback to a long list I'm working through for the next big update.
